body:
These are places in the **A. P. de Zoysa** Sinhala translation of the Aṅguttara Nikāya (Nines) that look like errors, found while reading the translation beside the Pāli.

Each item gives the paragraph number and sutta heading as the file gives them, and a **fix** link that opens the line on GitHub (the pencil icon there edits it). Then: **Now** (copied from that line), **Should be**, **Why**, and lines from your own files to **compare**. If an earlier fix has moved the line, the search text finds it. Some items may be our misunderstanding; corrections are welcome. Please tick an item when it is fixed, or reply with its ID.

- [ ] **PLK-488** · paragraph 19 (පච්ඡානුතාපීනී සූත්‍රය) · fix: [vagga_3411.xml line 161](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3411.xml#L161)
  - Now: අර්ත්‍ථය දැනගෙනථ ධර්‍මය දැනගෙන, ධර්මානුධර්මයෙන් (යුක්තව) පිළිපැද්දෙමු.
  - Should be: අර්ත්‍ථය දැනගෙන ධර්‍මය දැනගෙන, ධර්මානුධර්මයෙන් (යුක්තව) නොපිළිපැද්දෙමු.
  - Why: These deities examined the meaning of the teachings but did not practise in line with the Dhamma, which is why they were reborn in a low world (as the same sentence goes on to say). The text says they did practise («පිළිපැද්දෙමු»); «නො» is missing. There is also a stray ථ in «දැනගෙනථ».
  - Compare, Pāli of this sutta ([an-9.json line 2652](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-9.json#L2652)): නො ච ඛො අත්ථමඤ්ඤාය ධම්මමඤ්ඤාය ධම්මානුධම්මං පටිපජ්ජිම්හ
  - If the line has moved, search for: `ධර්මානුධර්මයෙන් (යුක්තව) පිළිපැද්දෙමු`
- [ ] **PLK-290** · paragraph 25 (පරිඤ්ඤාපරිවිත සූත්‍රය) · fix: [vagga_3412.xml line 68](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3412.xml#L68)
  - Now: අනිකක් කොදනිමියයි
  - Should be: අනිකක් නොදනිමියයි
  - Why: Spelling: «කොදනිමි» should be «නොදනිමි» (I know nothing beyond this), as in the same phrase in the next sutta.
  - Compare, the same phrase in the next sutta ([vagga_3412.xml line 78](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3412.xml#L78)): අනිකක් නොදනිමි
  - If the line has moved, search for: `අනිකක් කොදනිමියයි`
- [ ] **PLK-291** · paragraph 26 (සිලායුපොපම සූත්‍රය) · fix: [vagga_3412.xml line 80](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3412.xml#L80)
  - Now: දෙවෙනි වරත් යම් හෙයකින් වනාහි ඇවැත්නියි
  - Should be: Replace everything from «දෙවෙනි වරත්» to the end of this line with a full second round, like the first round (lines 78–80) and the third (lines 81–83): Candikāputta speaks to the monks a second time («“දෙවෙනි වරද ආයුෂ්මත් චන්‍ද්‍රිකාපුත්‍ර ස්ථවිර තෙමේ භික්‍ෂූන් ඇමතීය. …», as line 81 with «second» for «third»), and Sāriputta answers a second time that Devadatta does not teach so, but teaches so.
  - Why: The second round is broken: after «a second time» there is no speaker, only the teaching repeated twice; Candikāputta's second address and Sāriputta's second reply are missing. The Pāli gives the second round in full, like the first and third.
  - Compare, Pāli of this sutta (second and third rounds) ([an-9.json line 3750](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-9.json#L3750)): දුතියම්පි ඛො -පෙ- තතියම්පි ඛො ආයස්මා චන්දිකාපුත්තො භික්ඛු ආමන්තෙසි
  - Compare, the third round in this sutta ([vagga_3412.xml line 81](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3412.xml#L81)): “තෙවෙනි වරද ආයුෂ්මත් චන්‍ද්‍රිකාපුත්‍ර ස්ථවිර තෙමේ භික්‍ෂූන් ඇමතීය.
  - If the line has moved, search for: `දෙවෙනි වරත් යම් හෙයකින් වනාහි ඇවැත්නියි`
- [ ] **PLK-292** · paragraph 27 (පඨමවෙරභය සූත්‍රය) · fix: vagga_3412.xml lines [100](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3412.xml#L100), [116](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3412.xml#L116)
  - Now: කාමයන්හි වරදවා හැසිරීමෙන් වැළකුණහට මෙසේ ඒෙ වෛරීභය සංසිඳුනේ වෙයි.
  - Should be: කාමයන්හි වරදවා හැසිරීමෙන් වැළකුණහට මෙසේ ඒෙ වෛරීභය සංසිඳුනේ වෙයි. — then add the passage on lying, built like the passages before it: one who speaks falsehood (මුසාවාදය) produces fear and enmity here and hereafter and feels mental pain; one who abstains from false speech (මුසාවාදයෙන් වැළකුණේ) does not; so for him that fear and enmity is calmed. The passage on drink follows.
  - Why: One of the five fears and enmities is missing in both suttas (9. 1. 3. 7. and the next): the text gives killing, stealing, sexual misconduct and drink, yet ends «these five fears and enmities are calmed». The Pāli has lying between sexual misconduct and drink.
  - Compare, Pāli of 9. 1. 3. 7., items 2–5 (abbreviated) ([an-9.json line 3886](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-9.json#L3886)): අදින්නාදායී -පෙ- සුරාමෙරයමජ්ජපමාදට්ඨායී
  - Compare, Buddha Jayanthi's Sinhala, items 2–5 ([an-9.json line 3923](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-9.json#L3923)): කාමයෙහි මිසහසර ඇතියේ … මුසවා කියනුයේ … මද පමා දෙකට කරුණු රහමෙර බොනසුලුයේ
  - If the line has moved, search for: `වැළකුණහට මෙසේ ඒෙ වෛරීභය සංසිඳුනේ වෙයි. පමාවීමට කරුණුවූ`
- [ ] **PLK-293** · paragraph 27 (පඨමවෙරභය සූත්‍රය) · fix: vagga_3412.xml lines [103](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3412.xml#L103), [119](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3412.xml#L119)
  - Now: මහානාමය, යම් කාලයක ආර්‍ය්‍ය ශ්‍රාවකතෙම සංඝයා සිහි කරයිද
  - Should be: Delete from «මහානාමය, යම් කාලයක» to the end of the paragraph, «ධර්‍ම නැමැති සැඩපහරට බැස්සේ සංඝයා අරමුණුකොට ඇති සිහිය වඩයි.»; the paragraph should end at «ලෝකයාගේ ශ්‍රේෂ්ඨ පින් කෙතයයි සංඝයා සිහි කරයි.», and the next paragraph (the noble virtues) follows.
  - Why: A passage addressed to Mahānāma has been copied into both suttas (9. 1. 3. 7. to Anāthapiṇḍika and the next to the monks) from the sutta to Mahānāma in the Book of Sixes, where the same words stand. The Pāli goes straight on from confidence in the Saṅgha to the virtues dear to the noble ones.
  - Compare, Pāli of 9. 1. 3. 7., what follows the Saṅgha ([an-9.json line 3952](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-9.json#L3952)): 9. අරියකන්තෙහි සීලෙහි සමන්නාගතො හොති
  - Compare, the same passage in de Zoysa's sutta to Mahānāma, Book of Sixes ([vagga_3110.xml line 126](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3110.xml#L126)): මහානාමය, යම් කාලයක ආර්‍ය්‍ය ශ්‍රාවකතෙම සංඝයා සිහි කරයිද
  - If the line has moved, search for: `මහානාමය, යම් කාලයක ආර්‍ය්‍ය ශ්‍රාවකතෙම සංඝයා සිහි කරයිද`
- [ ] **PLK-294** · paragraph 31 (අනුපුබ්බ නිරෝධ සූත්‍රය) · fix: [vagga_3412.xml line 151](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3412.xml#L151)
  - Now: වීතීයධ්‍යානයට පැමිණියහුගේ
  - Should be: ද්වීතීයධ්‍යානයට පැමිණියහුගේ
  - Why: Spelling: «වීතීය» (second) has lost its first letter; it should be «ද්වීතීය».
  - Compare, the right spelling in the next file ([vagga_3413.xml line 52](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3413.xml#L52)): ද්වීතීය ධ්‍යාන
  - If the line has moved, search for: `වීතීයධ්‍යානයට පැමිණියහුගේ`
- [ ] **PLK-295** · paragraph 33 (අනුපුබ්බාසමාපත්ති සූත්‍රය) · fix: vagga_3413.xml lines [24](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3413.xml#L24), [52](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3413.xml#L52), [70](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3413.xml#L70), [73](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3413.xml#L73), [74](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3413.xml#L74), [174](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3413.xml#L174), [191](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3413.xml#L191), [194](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3413.xml#L194)
  - Now: වීතීය
  - Should be: ද්වීතීය — in every place in these lines where «වීතීය» stands as a word of its own (10 places: twice in lines 24 and 74, once in each of the others); leave the one already correct «ද්වීතීය ධ්‍යාන» in line 52 as it is.
  - Why: Spelling: «වීතීය» (second, of the second jhāna) has lost its first letter throughout suttas 9. 1. 4. 2. to 9. 1. 4. 10.; it should be «ද්වීතීය», as once in line 52.
  - Compare, the right spelling in the same file ([vagga_3413.xml line 52](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3413.xml#L52)): ද්වීතීය ධ්‍යාන
  - If the line has moved, search for: `වීතීය ධ්‍යාන`
- [ ] **PLK-296** · paragraph 33 (අනුපුබ්බාසමාපත්ති සූත්‍රය) · fix: vagga_3413.xml lines [24](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3413.xml#L24), [26](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3413.xml#L26), [28](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3413.xml#L28), [30](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3413.xml#L30), [32](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3413.xml#L32), [34](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3413.xml#L34), [36](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3413.xml#L36), [38](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_3413.xml#L38)
  - Now: අකුසල ධර්‍මයන්ගෙන් වෙන්ව, විතර්‍ක සහිත, විචාර සහිත, විවේකයෙන් හටගත් ප්‍රීතිය හා සැපය ඇති,
  - Should be: In each of these lines (attainments 2 to 9), replace the first-jhāna description (from «… වෙන්වම» through «… ප්‍රීතිය හා සැපය ඇති,») with that attainment's own description, as the translator gives them in sutta 9. 1. 4. 5., e.g. for the second jhāna (line 96): «විතර්‍ක විචාරයන්ගේ සංසිඳවීමෙන්, විතර්‍ක නැති, විචාර නැති, සමාධියෙන් උපන් ප්‍රීති සැපය ඇති,». For the formless attainments and cessation, only their own names are needed (as at line 30 «… ආකාසානඤ්චායතනයට …»), with no jhāna words.
  - Why: Every attainment after the first is given the first jhāna's words (secluded from sensual pleasures, with applied and sustained thought, rapture and pleasure born of seclusion), which belong only to the first jhāna.   - Now: ඇවැත්නි, සංඥා ඇත්තේම ඒ ආයතනය නොදනී. සංඥා නැත්තේ නොදනී.
  - Should be: ඇවැත්නි, සංඥා ඇත්තේම ඒ ආයතනය නොදනී. සංඥා නැත්තේ නොවේ. (probably: "it is not the one without perception")
  - Why: Ānanda's answer says the opposite of the Pāli: it is the one who has perception who does not experience that base, not the one without perception. As written, the second sentence says the one without perception does not experience it either.
  - Compare, Pāli of this sutta (9. 1. 4. 6.) ([an-9.json line 5139](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-9.json#L5139)): සඤ්ඤීමෙව ඛො ආවුසො තදායතනං නො පටිසංවෙදෙති. නො අසඤ්ඤීති
  - Compare, Buddha Jayanthi's Sinhala ([an-9.json line 5173](https://github.com/pathnirvana/tipitaka.lk/blob/master/public/static/text/an-9.json#L5173)): අචිත්තක වූයේ නො දන්නේ නො වෙයි

  - Why: The nun describes a concentration that is not bent by lust, not pushed away by hatred, and not held back by forceful suppression; here the third quality is written as positive ("held back"), both in her question and in Ānanda's reply.

  - Should be: විඤ්ඤාණඤ්චායතනයට පැමිණ වෙසේද, සර්‍වප්‍රකාරයෙන්

  - Now: එහි සම්බාධය කුමක්ද? එහි යම් ප්‍රීතියක් නිරුද්‍ධ නොවේද
  - Should be: එහි සම්බාධය කුමක්ද? එහි යම් විතර්‍ක විචාරයන් නිරුද්‍ධ නොවේද (probably: "applied and sustained thought")
  - Why: In the first jhāna the confinement is that applied and sustained thought have not yet ceased; rapture is the confinement of the second jhāna (the next paragraph), so it is named here one step too early.
